paragraph: In terms of submitting requests within your portal, you can make as many as necessary to cater for your needs in task management. It is easy to track all the ongoing, scheduled, and completed activities to enable one to track the progress of the work being done at all times.

title: Smooth Project Management at Your Fingertips

paragraph: Our comprehensive solution cuts across the entire creative process hence eliminating the need for a number of applications. This lets you attend to requests, sort files and work directly and interactively with your designers while being able to easily fit your workflow. It is more effective and easy to work this way because all tools that you need are collected in one place
author: Krishna Ramolia, Manager at RND Technosoft.
